By considering the velocity-time graph shown below, find the total distance the train travelled.
Tish runs a business selling packets of stickers. The number of stickers per packet is normally
distributed with a mean of 200 and a standard deviation of 2. In order to balance customer
satisfaction and profits, Tish only sells packets that contain between 198 and 204 stickers.
(a) If Tish produces 400 packets of stickers per month, how many of these can she sell?      3
(b) Given that a packet is unable to be sold, what is the probability that it contains fewer
stickers than average. Give your answer to the nearest percent.                                         2

number of mangoes grown each year.                                                                                 2
